TEXT.English: Military units sharing a tile provide temporary support to their teammates. Diverse armies gain complementary benefits; overcrowded forces suffer combat and healing penalties. Technologies increase the number of units that can operate together without overcrowding.

TEXT.English: Temporary support from other eligible units of the same team on this tile, unlocked by the listed technology. Scouts and explorers supply Recon aid without counting toward Overcrowded. Does not require movement points. Strength ratios determine the level; only the strongest effect in each support family applies.
